author: Argus
title: Cancelling a signer recovery re-validates approvals pre-signed for a predictable generation
summary: Scheduling a recovery and then cancelling it advances the signer generation twice while keeping the same signer. A generation sequence that can be predicted lets material signed in advance for a future generation become valid again, which contradicts the claim that cancellation invalidates signatures made during the pause.
